title: Distill, Debate, Discover: Grounding Multi-Agent Research Ideation in Graph-Distilled Insights
abstract: arXiv:2610.33366v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to support research idea generation and scientific discovery. Multi-agent debate offers a collaborative approach to this task by bringing together diverse perspectives to develop research ideas. However, a key challenge is how to equip agents with distinct and meaningful expertise to guide their contributions. Inspired by how researchers draw on accumulated research experience during collaboration, we introduce InsightAgents, a framework that constructs literature-grounded agent expertise by distilling insights from graphs of related papers. Guided by insights that trace evolving research approaches, reveal underlying assumptions, and identify unresolved challenges, within a line of research, agents jointly identify a research problem and propose, challenge, and refine potential approaches through debate to develop a research proposal. translated_title: 蒸馏、辩论、发现：将多智能体研究构思建立在图蒸馏洞察之上
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）正被越来越多地用于支持研究想法生成与科学发现。多智能体辩论通过汇集多样化的视角来共同发展研究想法，为这一任务提供了一种协作式方法。然而，一个关键挑战在于如何为各个智能体赋予独特且有意义的专长，以引导其贡献。受研究者在协作中运用其积累的研究经验这一方式的启发，我们提出了 InsightAgents，这是一个通过从相关论文的图谱中蒸馏洞察来构建基于文献的智能体专长的框架。在沿着某一研究方向追踪研究方法的演变、揭示其潜在假设并识别未解决挑战的洞察指引下，各智能体共同确定一个研究问题，并通过辩论提出、质疑和改进潜在的研究方法，从而形成一份研究提案。我们在三项研究构思任务上对 InsightAgents 进行了评估……
tldr: 提出 InsightAgents 框架，通过从相关论文图谱中蒸馏出的研究洞察（如方法演变、潜在假设和未决挑战）为多智能体赋予基于文献的独特专长，使其通过辩论协作提出并完善研究提案。
en_tdlr: InsightAgents is a framework that grounds multi-agent debate in literature-based expertise by distilling insights—such as evolving methods, underlying assumptions, and open challenges—from graphs of related papers, enabling agents to collaboratively identify research problems and develop research proposals.
